disclosure_note: Two independent users have been reported by the Lab. Their identities, specific uses and supporting evidence have not yet been published in the attributable external-use ledger, so they are not counted as public validation records.
counting_rule: An attributable external-use record requires a named Lab output, attributable user or institution, a concrete use, a date, and a citation, link, correspondence record or other reviewable evidence. Reported use may be shown separately but is not treated as public validation until the record is documented.
